 Our list of the most anticipated C-dramas to binge watch.
 Photo: Courtesy of Disney+ Singapore By  Natalie Hoe and Jolin Lam  -  published 26 Oct 2026 
 At a Glance Generated by AI Chinese dramas are having a major moment. Many Chinese stars like Zhang Linghe , Ding Yuxi and Esther Yu are also going global as ambassadors of luxury fashion houses , cementing their international influence.
 From angst-filled ‘wuxia’ (martial arts) stories like the acclaimed Pursuit of Jade to heartwarming love stories, there’s no shortage of binge-worthy flicks for you to get lost in. Below, our list of all the upcoming Chinese dramas you’ll want to add to your watchlist.

 23 October 2026: Tigers Sniff the Rose
 If you’re a fan of Blossom , Meng Zi Yi and Li Yun Ru are set to reunite on screen on Tigers Sniff the Rose as princess Mu Wan Yao and common-born scholar Yan Shang. The highly anticipated Chinese period drama follows the unlikely pair through the hardships of the imperial court, while battling a national crisis and bringing peace to their realm. 
 Tigers Sniff the Rose is now showing on Disney+ and WeTV. 
 2026: The Road to Glory
 Adapted from the web novel Gui Luan , The Road to Glory tells the story of market head Xiao Li and fallen princess Wen Yu. Determined to help Wen Yu reclaim her rightful place on the throne, Xiao Li stands by her side through thick and thin. Starring Zhang Ling He and Jelly Lin , this drama promises to showcase their compelling chemistry as their love story blooms.
 The Road to Glory premieres on WeTV. The release date is yet to be announced.

 2026: River of No Return
 Continuing the trend of 2026 historical dramas, River of No Return follows Crown Prince Zhu Zhanji, who finds himself trapped in Nanjing. Together with constable Wu Dingyuan, doctor Su Jingxi, and junior official Yu Qian, he must evade a relentless manhunt to make the treacherous 15-day journey back to Beijing.
 River of No Return premieres on iQIYI. The release date is yet to be announced.

 2026: In the Moonlight 
 In the Moonlight follows Bao Shang En as Li Yao Ying, a princess who is sold off in a political marriage. When she’s saved by a reclusive monarch, the both of them stand upon a forbidden love threatening to blossom.
 In the Moonlight premieres on iQIYI and WeTV. The release date is yet to be announced.
 2027: Empress Reborn
 Looking for a time-travel historical drama? Empress Reborn delivers just that. Following her death, Empress Shen Miao ( Meng Zi Yi ) is transported back to her teenage years, where she encounters the cunning Marquis Xie Jingxing ( Dylan Wang ). Together, these two masterminds join forces to fight back against a corrupt kingdom and restore peace.
 Empress Reborn premieres on WeTV. The release date is yet to be announced.
